title: Camman18 Birch Log
description: We all know Camman18 hates birch logs right? Well the top of the log now shows his face. So if you dare chop a birch tree, he'll be watching you.
body:
It's just Camman18, **definitely not disliking your will of chopping a birch log** (very ironic).
Cut that tree! You'll get a nice Camman jumpscare in the log.
Remember, kids ; _that's a warning to never chop a birch log_.
